items.summary: These are the approximate positions of the U.S. Navy’s deployed carrier strike groups and amphibious ready groups throughout the world as of Nov. 2, 2026, based on Navy and public data. In cases in which a CSG or ARG is conducting disaggregated operations, the chart reflects the location of the capital ship. Total Battle Force Deployed Underway 286 (USS 228, USNS 58) 104 (USS 73, USNS 31) (46 FDNF, 58 Rotational) 76 (58 Deployed, 18 Local) In Japan USS Tripoli (LHA-7) is in port in Sasebo, Japan.
